VERDICT: ISSUES
1. tests/integration/test_workflow_tool_gate.py:25 — The test covers only `mindmap_work_set_status`. `mindmap_work_mark`, `mindmap_work_set_kind` and `mindmap_work_assign` also had their `except` clauses widened, but nothing exercises them with a `WorkflowError`. Reverting any of those three edits would not fail a test. I could not run the test here, because pytest was blocked by the permission prompt. I judged it from reading the code only.
2. src/mem_mcp/mcp/tools/mindmap_work_set_status.py:19 — The acceptance says to import `WorkflowError` from `mem_mcp.mindmap.workflow`. The diff imports it from `mem_mcp.mindmap.workflow_errors` in all four tools. `src/mem_mcp/mindmap/workflow.py` does not exist, so the acceptance path cannot be followed as written. `_work_item_common.py` already imports the class, so the behaviour is the same. This is a deviation from the plan text, not a functional bug.

The four `except` widenings themselves are correct and match the acceptance. The one test checks that a disallowed `done` transition on a workflow-backed item gives `JsonRpcError(-32602)` with `data["code"] == "move_blocked"`.
